recipe.title: Clementine & Almond Snack Boxes
recipe.description: A simple portable snack of sweet whole clementines and crisp unsalted almonds, portioned for easy transport without unnecessary preparation.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 2 firm, fresh clementines; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.preparation: Keep whole and unpeeled for transport.
ingredients.notes: Choose fruit without soft patches or damaged peel.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 60 g; retail pack size may vary.
ingredients.notes: Prefer fresh, crisp unsalted almonds. Ready-roasted unsalted almonds are also suitable.

equipment.notes: Used to portion the almonds accurately.
Use containers suitable for carrying in a work bag or car.

mise_en_place.instruction: Inspect the clementines and discard any fruit with damaged, leaking or markedly soft areas. Leave the two sound clementines whole and unpeeled.
mise_en_place.endpoint: Two firm, intact clementines are ready for packing.
60 g almonds are measured and ready to divide between the two snack boxes.

procedure.title: Portion the almonds
procedure.instruction: Divide the 60 g almonds evenly between the two lidded snack containers, giving approximately 30 g almonds per serving.
procedure.endpoint: Each container holds approximately half of the almonds.

procedure.title: Add the clementines
procedure.instruction: Place 1 whole, unpeeled clementine into each snack container alongside the almonds, then close the lids securely. Keeping the fruit whole prevents citrus juice from softening the almonds during transport.
procedure.endpoint: Each sealed snack box contains 1 clementine and approximately 30 g almonds.

corrective_actions.condition: A clementine is too large to fit without crushing the fruit or almonds.
corrective_actions.action: Carry the whole clementine separately rather than peeling or cutting it in advance.

plating.instruction: At the time of eating, peel the clementine and eat it alongside the almonds.

storage.storage_instructions: The packed snack may be kept in a cool, dry place for the same day. If prepared further ahead, refrigerate the sealed boxes for up to 2 days. Keep the clementines whole until eating so the almonds remain crisp.

restaurant_quality_features: Simple ingredients kept in their best condition until eating
nutrition_notes: Almonds provide predominantly unsaturated fats, fibre and useful micronutrients.
Clementine contributes fruit, fibre and vitamin C.
Morning snacks have no minimum protein requirement.
critical_success_factors: Keep the clementines whole until eating so juice cannot soften the almonds.
Pack only sound, undamaged clementines for transport.
